comments: The free check needs no account. Paid options: full report, extended report with keyboard tests and AI review of image alt text, PDF upload checker and monthly monitoring.
features: Free online accessibility checker for websites and PDFs. It runs axe-core on a sample of pages against WCAG 2.2 AA and checks the PDFs a site links to (tags, language, title, alt text). Free: score and main issues. Paid report: how to fix each issue in plain language, who should fix it, the WCAG/EN 301 549 criterion, and an accessible PDF.
title: Sin Tropiezos
